headlines.title: What Insmed Stock's Premium Is Actually Buying
headlines.summary: Management has just raised the peak-sales estimate, and a large slice of it belongs to a drug still running Phase III trials.

headlines.title: Has Insmed (INSM) Risen Above Fair Value After Its 3 Year Run?
headlines.summary: Insmed stock has delivered a very large 3 year return, yet the current valuation checks and market multiples point to a price that leans expensive rather than clearly cheap. Insmed has returned roughly 4.8x over the past 3 years, which puts the recent performance firmly in the spotlight for anyone thinking about new money going in at current levels.

headlines.title: Insmed Tops Q2 Earnings Estimates, Stock Soars 34% on Brinsupri Uptake
headlines.summary: INSM tops Q2 revenue and earnings estimates as strong Brinsupri uptake drives a 34% stock jump and prompts sharply higher 2026 sales guidance.

headlines.title: US Stock Market Today S&P 500 Futures Edge Higher On Mixed Growth Signals
headlines.summary: The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Friday, Aug, 7 2026 US stock futures are slightly higher this morning, with E mini S&P 500 contracts up about 0.2%, as investors weigh strong services activity against softer hiring and shifting interest rate expectations. The composite PMI for July sits at 54.5, which is a broad scorecard showing private sector growth at a nine month high. However, input costs are at a 14 month high, so the cost of doing business is still rising.

headlines.title: Insmed (INSM) Is Up 30.6% After Steeply Narrowing Losses And Raising 2026 Revenue Guidance – What’s Changed
headlines.summary: Insmed Incorporated reported second-quarter 2026 results showing its net loss shrinking to US$13.24 million from US$321.69 million a year earlier, alongside strong revenue growth from BRINSUPRI and ARIKAYCE. The company also raised its 2026 revenue guidance and increased combined peak sales estimates for its three lead programs to more than US$14 billion, highlighting how its lung therapies are reshaping its financial profile.

description: Insmed Incorporated develops and commercializes therapies for patients with serious and rare diseases in the United States, Europe, Japan, and internationally. The company offers ARIKAYCE for the treatment of refractory nontuberculous mycobacterial lung infections, as well as is in phase 3 clinical trial for the treatment of mycobacterium avium complex lung disease as part of a combination antibacterial drug regimen for adult patients. It also develops brensocatib, an oral reversible inhibitor of dipeptidyl peptidase 1(DPP1) that is in phase 3 clinical trial for the treatment of bronchiectasis; and in phase 2 clinical trial for the treatment of chronic rhinosinusitis without nasal polyps and hidradenitis suppurativa. In addition, the company is developing treprostinil palmitil inhalation powder, an inhaled formulation of a treprostinil prodrug treprostinil palmitil, which is in phase 3 clinical trial for the treatment of pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease; and phase 2 clinical trial for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension. Further, it develops INS1201, a microdystrophin adeno-associated virus gene replacement therapy which is in phase 1 clinical trial for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy, as well as it is also developing pre-clinical research programs for gene therapy, AI-driven protein engineering, protein manufacturing, RNA end-joining, and synthetic rescue. In addition, it provides INS1148, monoclonal antibody targeting stem cell factor called SCF248 that is in phase-2 clinical trial for the treatment of interstitial lung disease, and asthma; and INS1202, an intrathecally delivered gene therapy which is in phase 1 of clinical trial for the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.  The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Bridgewater, New Jersey.
